capabilities: Apply named or hex colors to text via inline syntax
Edit colors by clicking colored text or swatches
Pick colors with a full color picker and vault presets
Add colors from the right-click context menu
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to color inline text without polluting files with HTML or highlight markup.
summary: Inline text colorer that applies $red or $ff5500 syntax with hidden markup, clickable swatches and a color picker.
